topics.name: Datasets
notes: - Dataset 是一组用于评估的样例（example），每个样例包含输入，通常还有期望输出（参考答案）。
- 来源：人工编写、从线上 trace 中挑选、用户反馈中的失败案例。
- 覆盖典型问题、边界情况和已知失败，并持续补充。
- 评估集和用于调提示词的样例要分开，避免过拟合。

topics.name: Evaluators
notes: - Evaluator 是给输出打分的函数，可以是规则、LLM-as-judge 或人工评审。
- 规则评估：精确匹配、格式校验、是否调用了正确工具，便宜且稳定。
- LLM-as-judge：用另一个模型按评分标准打分，适合开放式回答，但需要用人工标注样本校准并抽检。
- 离线评估：在数据集上运行实验，比较不同提示词或模型版本。
- 在线评估：对线上 trace 持续打分，发现回归。

questions.title: What does an example in an evaluation dataset usually contain?
questions.explanation: Inputs are fed to the application. Reference outputs, when present, are used by evaluators for comparison.

questions.title: Which are good sources of dataset examples?

options.text: Failing requests found in production traces
Edge cases and known hard inputs
Only the examples you already used to tune the prompt

questions.explanation: A useful dataset is diverse and includes failures. Reusing only tuning examples hides overfitting.

questions.title: Why keep an evaluation set separate from the examples you use to tune prompts?

options.text: To avoid overfitting the prompt to the examples and overestimating quality
Because datasets can only be used once

questions.explanation: Scores on examples you tuned against are optimistic. A held-out set shows how the system generalizes.

questions.title: Which kind of evaluator is cheapest and most deterministic for checking that an output is valid JSON?

options.text: A manual review of every output

questions.explanation: Formats can be checked with code. Save LLM judges for qualities that rules cannot capture.

questions.title: What is a known risk of LLM-as-judge evaluators?

options.text: The judge can be biased or inconsistent, so it should be calibrated against human labels

questions.explanation: Write clear criteria, spot-check results and compare with human judgments.

questions.title: What does exact_match return for these inputs?

options.text: False, because the comparison is case-sensitive
True, because the meaning is the same

questions.explanation: String equality is exact. Strict matching often needs normalization or a semantic evaluator for free-form answers.

questions.title: What is the difference between offline and online evaluation?

options.text: Offline runs the app on a dataset before release; online scores real production traces

questions.explanation: Use offline experiments to compare versions and online evaluation to monitor quality in production.
